names.name: Elizabeth Gregory
names.said: The one who was actually frying.

text.what: Hanson Gregory's mother, who by the Smithsonian's account made the deep-fried dough the ring story starts from.
text.story: She used her son's spice cargo — nutmeg, cinnamon, lemon rind — and put hazelnuts or walnuts in the centre, where the dough might not cook through, and called them doughnuts. That detail is the strongest reading of why a fried cake is named after a nut.
text.today: The son's version of the story travels; hers explains the word.
